Description: Verify that the app displays the branded loading splash screen with the original Klaso Academic Cap + AI Sparkle Logo on startup
Expected Result: Splash screen with correct logo is displayed for 2-3 seconds

Description: Verify that a Student can sign up using a valid @klaso.edu email and receives a 6-digit OTP
Expected Result: OTP is sent and user is registered successfully upon verification

Description: Verify that a Student sign up fails if the email domain is not @klaso.edu (e.g., @gmail.com)
Expected Result: Error message displayed indicating invalid email domain

Description: Verify that a Faculty can sign up using a valid @klaso.edu email and OTP
Expected Result: OTP is sent and faculty is registered successfully

Description: Verify that login succeeds with valid student/faculty/admin credentials
Expected Result: User is navigated to their respective dashboard

Description: Verify that login fails with incorrect password or unregistered email
Expected Result: Error message displayed 'Invalid credentials'

Description: Verify that the 'Forgot Password' flow sends a 6-digit OTP to the registered email
Expected Result: 6-digit OTP is sent to email

Description: Verify that the Student Dashboard displays real-time overall attendance percentage
Expected Result: Overall attendance matches the calculated attendance from database

Description: Verify that the Student Dashboard displays subject-wise attendance breakdown
Expected Result: List of subjects with their respective attendance percentages is shown

Description: Verify that the Low Attendance Warning System displays a Green (Good) indicator for attendance >= 75%
Expected Result: Green indicator is shown

Description: Verify that the Low Attendance Warning System displays a Yellow (Low Warning) indicator for attendance between 65% and 74%
Expected Result: Yellow indicator is shown

Description: Verify that the Low Attendance Warning System displays a Red (Critical Alert) indicator for attendance < 65% with a breakdown table
Expected Result: Red indicator and breakdown table of low-attendance subjects are shown

Description: Verify that the Dashboard correctly displays 'Today\'s Classes' along with Building, Block, and Room Number
Expected Result: Today's schedule is accurate with precise location details

Description: Verify that a 'Missed Class Card' is generated when a student is marked absent
Expected Result: Card appears in the missed classes section

Description: Verify that clicking a 'Missed Class Card' launches the AI Study Buddy pre-loaded with the missed class recap
Expected Result: AI Study Buddy opens with specific context of the missed class

Description: Verify that the AI Study Buddy provides context-aware clarification for academic doubts
Expected Result: AI provides accurate academic answers

Description: Verify that the AI Study Buddy strictly rejects non-academic prompts (e.g., jokes, movies) with a friendly academic redirect
Expected Result: AI refuses to answer and redirects to academic topics

Description: Verify that the 'Note Summarizer' generates Quick Summaries, Key Concepts, and Definitions from uploaded notes
Expected Result: Summarized content is structured and accurate

Description: Verify that the 'Exam Revision Mode' generates Exam Points and Last-minute Revisions
Expected Result: Key exam points are highlighted

Description: Verify that the 'AI Quiz Generator' generates exactly 5 dynamic MCQs
Expected Result: 5 MCQs are presented to the user

Description: Verify that the AI Quiz Generator provides a score report and detailed explanations after completion
Expected Result: Score and explanations are shown after quiz submission

Description: Verify that a Faculty member can view their assigned classes
Expected Result: Only classes assigned to the logged-in faculty are visible

Description: Verify that a Faculty member can mark attendance using individual checkboxes
Expected Result: Individual attendance is saved successfully

Description: Verify that a Faculty member can mark attendance using a bulk checkbox (select all)
Expected Result: All students are marked present/absent and saved successfully

Description: Verify that a Faculty member can view a low attendance warning roster for their students
Expected Result: Roster highlights students with <75% attendance

Description: Verify that a Faculty member can successfully upload PDF/text notes and lecture materials
Expected Result: File uploads successfully and is accessible to students

Description: Verify that the Admin Dashboard displays campus overview analytics (Total Students, Faculty, Subjects, Classes, Attendance %)
Expected Result: Analytics dashboard loads with correct aggregated data

Description: Verify that the Admin can manage authorized college email domains
Expected Result: Admin can successfully add or remove domains like @klaso.edu

Description: Verify that the Admin can activate or deactivate a user account
Expected Result: Deactivated users cannot log in; activated users can log in
